title: ArmorStandRedaction
description: Armor Stand Redaction is a simple armor stand editor mod.
body:
Armor Stand Redaction
🚨 Please notify me if you are installing this mod on a server. Specific configuration will be required—please provide the server IP address as well.
✨ Experience Total Control
Armor Stand Redaction is a comprehensive utility designed to push the boundaries of what is possible with armor stands in your world. This mod provides a sophisticated suite of tools for players and creators who demand precision and creative freedom beyond the vanilla limitations.
🛠️ Advanced Manipulation & Usage
Tired of static, lifeless displays? Armor Stand Redaction introduces a new layer of interaction.
To open the management menu, simply use Shift + Right-Click on an armor stand.
While the core mechanics remain intuitive, the underlying system allows for granular adjustments that were previously inaccessible. Whether you are building a grand museum, a cinematic scene, or a complex decorative environment, this tool adapts to your creative vision.
🔍 Key Features (Overview):

    Quick Access: Open the configuration interface instantly with Shift + Right-Click.
    Precision Refinement: Fine-tune every aspect of your armor stands with surgical accuracy.
    Visual Transformation: Go beyond basic posing; redefine how equipment and entities are presented.
    Workflow Optimization: Designed for both quick adjustments and deep, methodical scene building.
    Intuitive Interface: A powerful yet seamless experience that integrates directly into your creative process.
